mil3.2.7:1.3: “Enough, Great King! What is the point of asking me that? Did I not already tell you beforehand: ‘If I am grasping, Great King, I will be reborn; if I am not grasping, I will not be reborn’?”
mil3.2.7:2.2: “Suppose, Great King, a certain man were to do service for the king.
mil3.2.7:2.3: The king, pleased, would give him a reward; by that reward he would be provided and endowed with the five kinds of sensual stimulation, and would enjoy them. And suppose he were to announce to the people: ‘The king does nothing for me in return’.
mil3.2.7:2.4: Would that man be acting properly, Great King?”
mil3.2.7:2.6: “In the same way, Great King, what is the point of asking me that? Did I not already tell you beforehand: ‘If I am grasping, I will be reborn; if I am not grasping, I will not be reborn’?”
mil3.2.7:4.1: The Question on Whether the Elder Is Reborn or Not Reborn: Seventh.
